source.name: Footy Headlines: Adidas Neom SC 26-27 Home & Away Kits Released - No More Puma
source.note: Official 2026-27 kit launch report; its launch image shows OXAGON as the front-of-shirt sponsor on both the home and the away shirt, with no other sponsor mark on the front or sleeves.

source.name: NEOM S.C. (club announcement): NEOM Sports Club and SHG forge strategic partnership to shape the future of sports and enterprise
source.note: Three-season partnership announced December 2025: SHG's brand "will feature prominently on the front of NEOM S.C.'s official match jerseys". The 2026-27 launch images show only OXAGON on the shirt, so SHG's 2026/27 placement is to confirm.

summary: Adidas home kit (first Adidas season after Puma). The official launch images show OXAGON front-of-shirt and no other sponsor mark on the front or sleeves. The club's December 2025 announcement also puts SHG on the front of the match jerseys for three seasons, but SHG is not visible in the launch images, so its 2026/27 placement is to confirm. No cited source shows the back of the shirt or names a back, sleeve or shorts sponsor, so the sponsor list is not yet confirmed complete.
